title: CROA Governed Action Request (gar.*)
description: Structured input submitted by a governed agent to the Agent Surface. Normative source: CROA Standard Part II, Reference Architecture, §4.5.1. This schema is machine-readable companion material; in any discrepancy, Part II §4.5.1 prevails.

gar.request_id.description: Unique identifier generated by the governed agent; correlates the request with subsequent C5 events.

gar.type.description: Typed action class (e.g., code.write, api.invoke, data.read, config.change). Valid set defined in the applicable C1 policy artifact.

gar.target.description: Identifier of the governed external system or resource the action is directed at.

gar.parameters.description: Action-type-specific parameters, structured per the C1 policy artifact schema for gar.type.

gar.context_refs.description: Entities/APIs/services/data stores/dependencies the action references; C3 MUST resolve each against the technical golden record before forwarding to C2.

$comment: The agent MUST NOT include stated reasoning, urgency assertions, or compliance self-reports. The Agent Surface MUST reject any request containing fields outside this schema (event.rejection_reason = SCHEMA_VIOLATION).
